author: NASS
description:
I colorized, restored, and created a sound design for this fascinating footage of Boston in the 1960s. Experience the city as it looked during this era, with its streets, traffic, architecture, and everyday life brought back to life in color. The driving POV offers a unique glimpse into Boston’s past, recreating the atmosphere of the city as faithfully as possible.

🛠️ Video Restoration Process:
✔ FPS boosted to 60 frames per second
✔ Image resolution enhanced up to FHD quality
✔ Improved video sharpness and brightness with my own AviSynth scripts
✔ Colorized only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
✔ Sound design created for immersive atmosphere
✔ Full restoration: stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring made with my own AviSynth and VapourSynth scripts

Please, be aware that colorization colors are not real and fake, colorization was made only for the ambiance and do not represent real historical data.

B&W Video Source: A/V Geeks

Many thanks to  A/V Geeks for the
title: Boston 1960s in Color, Driving POV [60fps Remastered] | Sound Design
